|game_text=Deploy on [Vader] Vader. During your battle phase, may cancel this Effect to allow Vader to make a regular move. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Vader's Mask (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). No published image shows this text (the release-sheet copy that survives was re-made after the 28 June 2010 correction), so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-00-Vaders_Mask-original-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026). The re-made release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Vaders_Mask.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-vadersmask-pre.gif]]) show the PC-E1 text (see [[Vader's Mask (Errata)]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): first printing of the Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (official text as of 18 June 2010): “Deploy on [Vader] Vader. During your battle phase, may cancel this Effect to allow Vader to make a regular move. In order for opponent's character to move away from here, opponent must first lose 1 Force. While defending a battle at opponent's site, Vader is power +2 and immune to attrition. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 18 June 2010"; copy re-made 28 July 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174512/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> That first printing is not preserved; the text is the re-made sheet's text without the two words the Players Committee news post of 28 June 2010 says were added (“…to move away from here using landspeed.”).<ref name="src-S3">Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications", 28 June 2010. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20100714025225/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=244:some-minor-errors-and-clarifications&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=50 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Vader's Mask (Errata)]]): The Players Committee news post "Some minor errors and clarifications" (28 June 2010) added “using landspeed”: “Deploy on [Vader] Vader. During your battle phase, may cancel this Effect to allow Vader to make a regular move. In order for opponent's character to move away from here using landspeed, opponent must first lose 1 Force. While defending a battle at opponent's site, Vader is power +2 and immune to attrition. (Immune to Alter.)”<ref name="src-S3" /> The re-made Virtual Block 7.1 release sheet (copy re-made 28 July 2010), the PC website card list (2012–2013) and the Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) print the same text.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_1" /><ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
